features.name: has_multiple_oc_comments
features.definition: Does the discussion contain more than one counter-argument comment?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list. Return 1 if len(list) >= 2, 0 if len(list) <= 1 (a single comment gives 0; empty list gives 0). Return null if missing or malformed JSON. Counts list entries; no semantic filtering.

h0: There is no difference in the likelihood of view change between discussions with multiple counter-argument comments and those with a single comment (coefficient of has_multiple_oc_comments is 0).
h1: Discussions with has_multiple_oc_comments = 1 have a higher likelihood of view change than those with a single comment.
note: Operational assumptions: "multiple distinct comments" is measured as 2+ entries in OC_comments versus exactly 1; list length counts comments, not necessarily distinct commenters, and distinctness of arguments is not assessed. Rows with an empty list (none observed in inspection; min was 1) would be coded 0. OLS on binary delta is a linear probability model; association only. OC_comments may contain outcome-related text, but this is a raw count so no filtering is applied; available comments may be a subset selected in the corpus.
